input.subject: [E18] Damaged PS5 Box
input.body: Hey ByteMart, I received my PS5 order today, but the parcel box was wet and torn, and the PS5 box inside is also damaged and torn. Fortunately, the console and accessories are not damaged and the console is working, but this is very disappointing. I may need the original box if I resell the console in the future. I request a replacement box or, if possible, a replacement console at the earliest. Until this is resolved, I will not use the PS5 and will keep it packed in its original condition. I was really excited to play, so this experience has been disappointing. Please respond as soon as possible. Email: rishit1@gmail.com. Order No: BM728349.
